settings.agents.costMeterLabel: Cost & context meter for Claude panes
settings.agents.costMeterHint: Shows Claude Code's own estimate (list price; on a subscription that is API-equivalent value, not a bill) and context use in each Claude pane header, in Mission Control and in Fleet. Gridkeeper starts Claude with a --settings file in its own data folder that sets only statusLine. Claude then hands Gridkeeper the status line numbers: session id, cost, durations, context size and use, token counts, the current usage breakdown, rate limits and the model name. Nothing from transcripts or credentials is read. It replaces Claude's status line in Gridkeeper panes, unless you have your own: then Gridkeeper runs yours and it shows as before (it finds it by reading statusLine from your Claude settings files, read-only). A pane that passes its own --settings isn't metered. Codex and Gemini CLI report no usage to other programs (shown as n/a). Applies to newly started Claude panes: restart a pane to apply.

replay.noProjectHint: Set a project folder for the workspace, open Mission Control and create a mission; replays record from there.
replay.emptyWhat: A mission replay is recorded from what Gridkeeper already sees while your agents work: the mission goal and task board (.gridkeeper/mission.md), each agent’s state (working, needs you, done), branch stats (commits, files, lines) and short messages between agents (briefs, hand-offs, broadcasts).
replay.emptyPrivacy: It never records terminal output, file contents, environment variables, paths or account e-mails. Recordings are small JSON-lines files in .gridkeeper/replay/ next to the mission file (ignored by git). Recording starts automatically when Mission Control shows a mission (if enabled below), or press Record.
